about: Texas county and city grant programs, entered by hand from each program's own page. Not a complete list. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date (docs/county-coverage.md).

programs.title: Support for Organizations
programs.agency: Houston Arts Alliance for the City of Houston
programs.objectives: Annual support for arts and cultural activities open to the public, paid from the city's hotel occupancy tax.
programs.who: 501(c)(3) nonprofits and fiscally sponsored organizations, based within Houston city limits.
programs.application: Apply through the alliance's grants portal.
programs.deadlines: The 2027 round closed July 24, 2026. One cycle a year; no next date is published.

programs.title: Festival Grant
programs.agency: Houston Arts Alliance for the City of Houston
programs.objectives: Arts festivals or arts parts of cultural festivals.
programs.who: Individual artists, 501(c)(3) organizations and fiscally sponsored projects. Applicants must be based within Houston city limits; an organization without 501(c)(3) status applies through a fiscal sponsor that has it.
programs.application: Apply through the alliance's grants portal.
programs.deadlines: The 2027 round closed July 24, 2026. One cycle a year; no next date is published.

programs.title: City's Initiative
programs.agency: Houston Arts Alliance for the City of Houston
programs.objectives: Creative opportunities that engage visitors and residents and build on Houston's cultural identity and tourism.
programs.who: Individual artists, organizations and fiscally sponsored projects. Applicants must be based within Houston city limits; an organization without 501(c)(3) status applies through a fiscal sponsor that has it.
programs.application: Apply through the alliance's grants portal; three rounds a year.
programs.deadlines: Round 3 of 2026, the last of three, closed September 26, 2026. No next date is published.

programs.title: Let Creativity Happen
programs.agency: Houston Arts Alliance for the City of Houston
programs.objectives: Specific programs that take creative risks in the City of Houston.
programs.who: Individual artists, organizations and fiscally sponsored projects. Applicants must be based within Houston city limits; an organization without 501(c)(3) status applies through a fiscal sponsor that has it.
programs.application: Apply through the alliance's grants portal; three rounds a year.
programs.deadlines: Round 3 of 2026, the last of three, closed September 26, 2026. No next date is published.

programs.title: ArtsActivate 2027, Round 3
programs.agency: City of Dallas Office of Arts and Culture
programs.objectives: Project-based cultural funding; each proposal needs a public event.
programs.who: Nonprofit arts and cultural organizations, social service organizations, individual artists, artist collectives and other eligible nonprofits.
programs.application: Apply through the portal linked on the page.
programs.deadlines: Round 3 opens February 9, 2027 and closes March 1, 2027.
programs.source_note: The guidelines weren't read (their host's robots.txt can't be read), so check them for matching funds and tax status rules.

programs.title: CDBG Public Service Projects (PY2027)
programs.area: Tarrant County outside Arlington, Fort Worth and Grand Prairie
programs.objectives: Social, transportation and educational services in the urban county area, outside Arlington, Fort Worth and Grand Prairie.
programs.who: Nonprofit organizations with an existing Unique Entity Identifier (UEI); include your tax exemption determination letter.
programs.application: Email the proposal to the contact named in the request for proposals.
programs.award: Not stated. Paid monthly by reimbursement.

programs.title: Emergency Solutions Grant (PY2027)
programs.who: Local nonprofit service providers who directly assist people who are homeless or at risk.
programs.application: Email the proposal to the contact named in the request for proposals.
programs.award: Up to $130,000 in all. The ESG program requires a 100% match.
programs.deadlines: Proposals are due Friday, January 15, 2027, at 12 noon.

programs.title: Arts Operational Grants (FY2027)
programs.agency: City of San Antonio Department of Arts and Culture
programs.objectives: Operating support for San Antonio arts and culture nonprofits, awarded on a three-year cycle (FY 2025 to FY 2027) with a yearly entry point for newly eligible groups.
programs.who: 501(c)(3) organizations headquartered in San Antonio with three years of operation and a budget of $50,000 to $15 million. Fiscal sponsors are not eligible.
programs.application: Intent to apply first, then the application in the city's grant portal.
programs.award: A share of operating expenses set by budget size, up to 30 percent.
programs.deadlines: Closed. The FY 2027 application opened February 23, 2026.
programs.source_note: The city's page gives two closing dates: March 6, 2026 in its timeline and March 13, 2026 in its apply steps. The earlier date is used here.
